name: King Narfi
description: A frozen mummy king of Karfell with an army of Dread Marn who agreed to keep Valki imprisoned in return for first pick of treasure at the Doomskar.

description_citations.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt chains Valki and imprisons him in King Narfi's glacial palace in Karfell, striking a deal with Narfi.
timeline.quote: So long as Valki stayed deep in the dungeon of this King Narfi's glacial palace

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.
